images.caption: Figure 1:AutoVend connects Web-based agent decisions to distributed physical retail through shared inventory, procurement lead times, and paid on-site replenishment.

Figure 2:Overview of AutoVend.
(a) Agent and interface, with MCP tools for remote operations, physical execution, and persistent memory.
(b) World simulator, connecting a shared warehouse to 20 machines across five site types and generating sales through a data-grounded demand model with hidden parameters.
(c) Daily interaction loop, from arrivals and recurring fees through agent queries and actions to sales and visit-cost settlement, followed by advancement to the next day.
